style.backgroundSystem: photographic sky depth rather than flat colour blocks: a graded sky photo field #8CC0EA with soft cloud massing #FFFFFF and one thin ocean horizon strip #1F6FB2 along its lower edge for every model read; a pale sky page field #DCEEFC carrying rounded paper-white #FFFFFF cards, coupon tickets with punched side notches and one dashed perforation rule; one white feathered cloud edge along the top of each promo band; hairline cobalt #1268D3 slash-rule groups flanking every section title; one oversized letter-spaced Latin display word ghosted behind the subject as a pure graphic layer carrying no brand wording
style.direction: bright summer seaside womenswear campaign detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in cobalt #1268D3 centred inside solid paper-white #FFFFFF circles, one glyph per point; solid cobalt #1268D3 rounded pill buttons each carrying one small chevron; ticket-shaped coupon cards with one punched notch per side and a dashed perforation rule; price set in red #E23B34 with a small currency glyph; hairline dot markers with leader lines for construction annotations; one straw-gold #D6A94E line-drawn wide-brim sun motif per section, at most one per screen; no filled 3D icons, no seals, no authority badges, no QR codes
style.lightingSystem: bright hard summer daylight at 5600-6000K, high key, sun placed high on one side with one visible lens-flare bloom and a faint light streak across the sky, crisp short shadows falling directly under the chin, the arm and the hem, controlled specular on white fabric, cool reading with no amber cast, identical sun direction and shadow length inside every panel of one layout
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent bright summer seaside womenswear campaign detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-white page stock #FFFFFF, pale sky page field #DCEEFC, graded sky photo field #8CC0EA, sea horizon deep blue #1F6FB2, cobalt title and button blue #1268D3, straw-gold motif #D6A94E and price red #E23B34, plus one accent color matched to the product supplied as {accent_color} at generation time; cool reading throughout; one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin, a heavy two-line Chinese headline in cobalt #1268D3 with one thin letter-spaced Latin ghost line beside it and section titles bracketed by hairline cobalt slash-rule groups, all rendered Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, headline 30-44pt, subhead 18-22pt, labels 12-16pt, no dense body text; background system of photographic sky depth with cloud massing #FFFFFF and one thin ocean horizon strip #1F6FB2 along the lower edge behind every model read, rounded paper-white #FFFFFF cards and notched coupon tickets floating on the pale sky field #DCEEFC, one white feathered cloud edge along the top of each promo band and one oversized letter-spaced Latin display word ghosted behind the subject as a pure graphic layer carrying no brand wording; lighting system of bright hard summer daylight at 5600-6000K, high key, sun placed high on one side with one visible lens-flare bloom and a faint light streak, crisp short shadows directly under the chin, arm and hem, no amber cast, identical sun direction and shadow length inside every panel of one layout; layout system of thin single-weight line glyphs inside solid paper-white circles, solid cobalt rounded pill buttons with one chevron, ticket cards with punched notches and a dashed perforation rule, hairline dot markers with leader lines and one bordered table with a solid #1F6FB2 header row above open value rows; one straw-gold #D6A94E line-drawn wide-brim sun motif per section, at most one per screen; product presentation rules: one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the jaw or turned away, or the garment laid flat, paired halter straps, straight bust line, shirred waist band and A-line skirt body kept readable in every panel, consistent front 3/4 read across scenes, stable scale and centring, relaxed fully formed hands never covering the bodice construction, the woven straw hat and dark eyewear treated as styling props only; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent sun direction or colour temperature, no mismatched glyph, ticket, button or table styles, no identifiable faces, no brand pill, no watermark, no QR code, no membership badge, no real price, discount, date, size or fibre numbers.

no mismatched glyph, ticket, pill-button or table styles
no identifiable model faces or source likeness
no brand pill, watermark, QR code or membership badge

style.presentationRules: the dress is worn by one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the jaw or turned away, or laid flat, so no facial identity ever carries; the paired halter straps at shoulder and neck, the straight bust line, the shirred waist band and the A-line skirt body stay readable in every panel; the front 3/4 read stays consistent across scenes so the item reads as the same object; stable scale and centring; hands relaxed with fully formed fingers and never covering the bodice construction; the woven straw hat and dark eyewear are styling props only and are never presented as part of the product
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper card stock for infographic screens; pale sand #EAE0D2 and weathered boardwalk timber #C9A97F for scenes; the garment's own shirred band and pintuck face as the macro surface; the garment laid flat and squared on the sky field for overhead screens
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for Chinese and Latin; heavy two-line Chinese headline in cobalt #1268D3 with one thin letter-spaced Latin ghost line beside it, one optional vertical side caption with small heart glyphs, section titles bracketed by hairline cobalt slash-rule groups; all rendered Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; headline 30-44pt, subhead 18-22pt, labels 12-16pt; no dense body text, no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon faces
